name: smartthings-hue
description: SmartThings but with the Philips Hue experience

scripts.build:native: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.build:pwa-reset: PWA_SELF_DESTROY=1 vite build && npm run deploy:check:reset
scripts.deploy:check: node --input-type=module -e "import { access, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; const required = ['dist/index.html', 'dist/404.html', 'dist/CNAME', 'dist/sw.js', 'dist/manifest.webmanifest', 'dist/icons/icon-192.png', 'dist/icons/icon-512.png', 'dist/icons/apple-touch-icon.png', 'dist/icons/splash.png']; await Promise.all(required.map(file => access(file))); const cname = (await readFile('dist/CNAME', 'utf8')).trim(); if (cname !== 'smarthue.sebastianthulin.se') throw new Error('Unexpected CNAME: ' + cname); const html = await readFile('dist/index.html', 'utf8'); if (!html.includes('./manifest.webmanifest')) throw new Error('Missing relative PWA deployment assets in dist/index.html'); if (!html.includes('./icons/apple-touch-icon.png') || !html.includes('./icons/splash.png')) throw new Error('Missing configured install assets in dist/index.html'); if (html.includes('href=\"/') || html.includes('src=\"/')) throw new Error('Found root-relative asset URLs in dist/index.html'); if (!html.includes('maximum-scale=1.0') || !html.includes('user-scalable=no')) throw new Error('Viewport zoom lock is missing in dist/index.html'); const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile('dist/manifest.webmanifest', 'utf8')); if (manifest.start_url !== './' || manifest.scope !== './' || manifest.id !== './') throw new Error('Manifest is not configured for relative deployment'); if (manifest.orientation !== 'portrait') throw new Error('Manifest orientation is not locked to portrait'); if (!Array.isArray(manifest.screenshots) || !manifest.screenshots.some((shot) => shot.src === './icons/splash.png')) throw new Error('Manifest screenshots are missing the splash asset'); console.log('Deployment artifact is ready for root and subdirectory hosting.');"
scripts.deploy:check:reset: node --input-type=module -e "import { access, readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; const required = ['dist/index.html', 'dist/404.html', 'dist/CNAME', 'dist/sw.js', 'dist/manifest.webmanifest']; await Promise.all(required.map(file => access(file))); const sw = await readFile('dist/sw.js', 'utf8'); if (!sw.includes('self.registration.unregister()')) throw new Error('Reset build did not emit a self-destroying service worker'); console.log('Emergency PWA reset artifact is ready to deploy.');"
